{{Quote
|The charting of caverns, the memory of travel, the knowing of one's place within the kingdom, an engaging task for a warrior's mind.
An unfortunate thing that my great mentor never learnt the skill. Her talent at getting lost... I should almost be impressed...
|[[Shakra]]
|Hr=SS
}}

The <b>Map</b> and <b>Quill</b> are [[Items (Silksong)|Items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. The Map charts the various rooms, passages, and chambers within [[Pharloom]], while the Quill is used to update the Map as new areas are discovered.

__TOC__

To start mapping an [[Areas (Silksong)|area]], an incomplete area map must first be obtained. Most of these are purchased from [[Shakra]], and if she is missed in an area (usually by defeating the area [[Bosses (Silksong)|boss]]), she can be found in [[Bone Bottom]] or, later, [[Bellhart]], and the map purchased there. However, for areas in [[the Citadel]], maps instead must be purchased from machines located in the area, and a handful of other areas have maps that must be found rather than purchased.

The entire world map can be viewed by pressing [[Controls (Silksong)|INVENTORY]] and scrolling to the Map page. This can also be accessed by double-tapping QUICK MAP instead of navigating through the menu. Holding down QUICK MAP opens an overlaid map of the current area, allowing [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to walk around while reading the map.

To complete the map, the Quill must be purchased from Shakra, or taken from [[Trobbio]]'s desk in the [[Whispering Vaults]]. After uncharted areas have been explored, resting at a [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]] will update the map. Explored areas of the map appear as coloured segments with solid outlines. Most of the time, entering a room fills the entire room on the map; however, some rooms will only be partially revealed until the room is explored fully.
